## Architecture constraints (verified by master gate)

- **D-RI-13 — no direct Prisma/MMM query from Runtime:** verified across the entirety of `src/runtime/` (every `.js`/`.jsx`/`.ts`/`.tsx` file, excluding `__tests__/`), not just the newest module.
- **Runtime never imports `backend/`:** same full-tree scan.
- **SSOT read-only:** `docs/meta-model/`, `docs/platform-architecture/`, `docs/platform-behavior/`, `docs/platform-protocol/`, `docs/platform-authoring/`, `docs/runtime-implementation/` — zero diff against `origin/main` for this slice.
- **Production UI untouched:** `src/App.jsx`, `src/shared/`, `src/framework/`, `src/modules/`, `src/studio/` — zero diff against `origin/main` for this slice.
- **No external service dependency in any gate, including the master gate:** every check is either a filesystem read, a static regex scan, an in-process `node --test` run, or an in-process engine instantiation — no network call, no database connection.

## Runtime capabilities delivered (cumulative, C.1–C.17)

- Bootstrap lifecycle (RT-0 → RT-8) with an injectable Service Locator wiring every one of M01–M24.
- CRB-driven registry hydration, dependency resolution, and routing (`canActivate`).
- Permission-gated Action/Workflow/Render/Expression/Formula/Validation/Execution pipeline.
- Runtime-local State, Plugin, and Connector engines (host-registered handlers/adapters, no direct backend calls).
- Runtime-local infrastructure trio (Cache, Event Bus, Transaction) — deterministic, in-memory, no external broker/queue/database.
- Runtime-local Observability (events/metrics/traces/error capture/health/readiness) with sensitive-data masking and no external telemetry export.
- A static, read-only Foundation C completeness audit (`RuntimeCompletion`) that never executes real business logic and never throws for an absent module.

## Not Yet Done

- **Backend-facing `ITransactionManager` implementation** (real Prisma transaction wrapper) — `TransactionEngine` only coordinates host-registered local participants; no BE adapter exists.
- **External telemetry export** for Observability (OpenTelemetry/Sentry/Datadog-style shipping) — `ObservabilityEngine` buffers locally only.
- **Persistence across process restarts** for State/Cache/Transaction/Observability — all runtime-local infra is in-memory only.
- **RT-8 end-to-end validation against a second real CRB module beyond `empresas`** — Foundation C's integration tests exercise the `empresas` fixture; broader multi-module E2E coverage is a candidate for a future hardening pass, not built in this slice.
- **Runtime v2 shadow-mode integration** — the legacy runtime bridge and the new Foundation C runtime coexist by design (`bridge`), but no shadow-mode dual-execution/comparison harness has been built yet.

## Recommended Next Step

**Foundation C closure review + plano de integração runtime v2 em modo sombra.**

This is a documented recommendation only — it is not an authorization to begin that work. Foundation C (M01–M24) is complete, gated, and regression-tested as of this slice; the natural next step is a maintainer-led closure review of the full Foundation C surface, followed by a separate, explicitly-scoped planning exercise for running the new runtime alongside the legacy bridge in shadow mode (dual execution + comparison, no user-facing behavior change) before any production cutover is considered.
